baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction فَإِذَا هُم بِـ presents the plural group as already in a bi-marked state or locus.
baseline_models.mechanism: Resultive fa plus surprise idha suppresses any intervening process: the group is encountered all at once in or on al-sahirah.

activation_trace.role: The focus noun names the wakeful exposed state in which the group is suddenly found, while the clause supplies the abrupt emplacement.

changed_reading.after: All at once, the same group finds itself already in or on al-sahirah.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلسَّاهِرَةِ is a definite feminine nominal anchored in the focus root س ه ر and retains the image of wakefulness or sleeplessness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The active, feminine shape can be substantivized as a named condition or locus characterized by being awake, while the preposition keeps state and place readings simultaneously available.

activation_trace.role: The focus noun cites the sleeplessness and wakefulness inventory directly, anchoring the model in the focus root rather than treating the ayah as rootless.

changed_reading.before: Al-sahirah is an opaque destination label.
changed_reading.after: Al-sahirah is the wakeful or sleepless condition, or a locus named through that condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding one voiced rebuke supplies a discrete trigger, and فَإِذَا in the focus presents its collective locative result as already complete.

activation_trace.role: A rebuke delivered by voice supplies the acoustic impulse whose completed effect appears in the focus.
Numerical singleness makes the transition one indivisible trigger rather than a narrated process.

structural_cues: 79:13 is immediately adjacent to 79:14, which begins with resultive fa and surprise idha.
The singular event is followed by plural هُم, widening one impulse into a collective result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one voiced rebuke, singleness, and adjacency; I infer a causal arrow from that event to the state introduced by فَإِذَا. Mere temporal succession remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The group is suddenly present, with the means of transition unspecified.
changed_reading.after: One vocal impulse instantaneously effects the group's completed presence in or on al-sahirah.

context_deltas.mechanism: A cluster of return-to-origin and recurrence images turns the focus locative into the realized answer to the speakers' incredulous question: al-sahirah is where their denied return becomes present fact.

activation_trace.role: Return to a thing or restoration to its place supplies the backward movement that the focus abruptly completes.
Return to the beginning makes the questioned destination an original condition rather than an unrelated new venue.
Recurrence after a prior turn supplies the repetition the speakers call a loss and the focus then realizes.

structural_cues: 79:10-12 frame return as an incredulous question and a losing recurrence; 79:13-14 answer with a compressed event-result pair.
The plural speakers of 79:10-12 recur as plural هُم in 79:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three convergent return images and continuous plural reference; I infer that 79:14 answers the mocked return rather than opening an unrelated scene. Al-sahirah could still name only the venue of that return.

changed_reading.before: Al-sahirah is simply the place reached after an unexplained transition.
changed_reading.after: Al-sahirah is the manifest destination of the very return-to-origin that the speakers had treated as impossible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Levelness, the lower counterpart to heaven, and uncovered open space converge on the focus's bi-marked noun, shifting al-sahirah from a merely wakeful condition to an exposed terrestrial expanse.

activation_trace.role: A wide smooth tract of land supplies the level geometry of the focus destination.
Earth as the lower counterpart to heaven locates the otherwise ambiguous al-sahirah terrestrially.
An uncovered open space adds public exposure to the level-earth model.

structural_cues: 79:27-30 moves from building and leveling above to spreading the earth below.
79:36 repeats the focus's disclosure logic by making a formerly unseen destination visible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies smooth ground, earth below heaven, open exposure, and a later earth-spreading sequence; I identify their shared spatial profile with the bi-marked al-sahirah. A nonspatial wakeful-state reading remains live.

changed_reading.before: Al-sahirah names wakefulness or an unspecified destination.
changed_reading.after: Al-sahirah is the leveled, uncovered earth-surface on which the group is suddenly displayed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah actively darkens night, brings what was hidden outward, and closes by compressing duration between evening and bright morning; against that temporal field, al-sahirah becomes a threshold of irreversible wakefulness and visibility.

activation_trace.role: The active darkening of night supplies the concealed condition from which the focus wakefulness departs.
Night and its darkness provide the native temporal field for the focus root's sleeplessness.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the directional move from hidden night into exposed awareness.
The brightness and clarity of forenoon supplies the visible pole of the wakefulness threshold.
Evening time supplies the near-night pole paired with morning at the surah's close.

structural_cues: 79:29 pairs darkening night with bringing out forenoon in a single balanced clause.
79:46 closes the surah by pairing evening and forenoon while collapsing experienced duration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies darkness, concealment-to-emergence, evening, and bright morning; I infer that the focus root turns this cycle into a permanent waking threshold. The same cues may instead be temporal framing around a literal plain.

changed_reading.before: The wakefulness in al-sahirah is a static lexical echo.
changed_reading.after: Al-sahirah marks the abrupt crossing out of nightlike concealment into an exposed state from which there is no return to sleep.

context_deltas.mechanism: Remembering after forgetfulness, direct seeing, and warning that awakens caution give the focus root a cognitive and ethical function: al-sahirah is also the condition of being fully awake to consequence.

activation_trace.role: Recovery of what was forgotten supplies the restoration of awareness within the focus wakefulness.
Sight by eye or insight makes the awakened condition one of unavoidable recognition.
Warning that frightens and awakens caution supplies an explicit cognitive waking mechanism.

structural_cues: 79:35-36 sequences recollection of action and visual disclosure of consequence.
79:45 identifies warning, rather than date calculation, as the relevant response to the coming event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recovered memory, sight, and caution-awakening warning; I transfer that awakening function to the focus lexeme. Alternatively, these cues describe responses after arrival without defining al-sahirah itself.

changed_reading.before: Al-sahirah denotes bodily sleeplessness or a physical plain.
changed_reading.after: Al-sahirah also names total awakened recognition: memory, sight, and consequence become simultaneously present.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ر د د to م ر د mapping rather than the source word's ordinary return branch. It remains anchored by the focus's bi-marked locus and the packet-authorized smooth-surface image; downstream prose should call it a branch activation, not an etymology of ٱلسَّاهِرَةِ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The prepositional phrase بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ permits al-sahirah to be construed as a supporting surface or platform.

activation_trace.role: The split inventory's smooth polished surface turns the destination of return into a prepared bare platform.

changed_reading.before: Return is only backward motion toward a destination.
changed_reading.after: The return lands on a smoothed, stripped platform heard provisionally in the locative al-sahirah.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The convergence is surprising because a place-name branch, a transgression-root branch, and a creation-root branch are each remote from their local surface forms. Their independent level-and-smooth images still converge on the focus's locative noun; render this only as a cross-branch spatial resonance, not lexical derivation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ anchors the reading to a locus capable of being level, smooth, and occupied.

activation_trace.role: An even place or surface contributes the first branch-distant image of a planed destination.
A smooth rock contributes hardness and bareness to the same destination image.
Smoothness and evenness of a surface turns the cluster into a made or prepared plane.

changed_reading.before: Al-sahirah is broadly an exposed tract of earth.
changed_reading.after: Al-sahirah can be imagined, exploratorily, as a deliberately planed and hardened assembly surface.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Personifying the destination as watchful is odd because the sight roots belong to people and the exposed fire, not grammatically to al-sahirah. The feminine active shape and repeated visibility cues keep the image anchored; downstream prose should mark it as personification rather than a literal agent claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The active feminine form ٱلسَّاهِرَةِ can support a personified 'wakeful one' while بِـ still locates the group upon or within it.

activation_trace.role: Physical eyesight introduces the visual field that the personified wakeful surface governs.
The blazing or protruding eye image gives the disclosed scene an unsettling watchful quality.
Actual sight or insight completes the reciprocal field in which everything is visible and nothing sleeps unseen.

changed_reading.before: The resurrected group is awake on an inert exposed surface.
changed_reading.after: The group is upon a figuratively wakeful, watchful surface where seer and seen are both exposed.

strongest_changes: The one voiced rebuke changes the focus from unexplained suddenness into an event-result transition.
The return cluster makes al-sahirah the realized answer to the denied return-to-origin.
Level-earth and exposure branches make the focus noun a public terrestrial surface without eliminating its wakefulness sense.
summary.what_was_special: Because the focus root has no supplied branch inventory, its compact clause stayed polysemous while whole-surah context activated three separable mechanisms: instantaneous emplacement, exposed level ground, and awakened recognition.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the wakefulness value defines the destination, personifies it, or merely resonates with a conventional place noun cannot be settled from the packet.
The smooth-platform outliers depend on deliberately distant branch mappings and should not displace the stronger return and exposed-earth models.
The causal force assigned to the single rebuke is strongly suggested by adjacency but remains a reader-supplied arrow.
